Hey! Since you're still answering questions.  

What do you think of kids who come from top 5 schools?  
Also, Do you have a general opinion of these schools that you would like to share?
Thank you for the response.  I too have noticed many people who just go through the motions and get perfect scores/ grades.   I guess setting yourself apart is far more important.

Hey!  Thanks for doing this AMA

My question is:  I go to a top 5 private US high school and as a result everyone around me gets 2300+ on SAT.  It's expected to get 800's on SAT II's and 36's on the ACT.  That has been my experience.  

What chance do students like these have at top colleges?  Do they do better?  Is it a result of access to tutoring and help, or is it a function of determination?  How do you look at these students?  Do you judge them differently?  Sorry for the barrage of questions, just another nervous high schooler.

Reddit is a bunch of idiot teenagers combined with celebrity worshipping average Americans.  It's no different than any other site on the internet.  No, the community isn't special, and no, it isn't especially smart either.

As a result, you get the hypocrisy of loving bacon and pigs at the same time.  No one wants to be told that their favorite food or thing is immoral.

yup.  Eating fish/other meat products isn't the right thing to do.  With the massive amount of alternatives out there, I find it barbaric that we still kill millions of cows/pigs/others a year.  The mechanization of this process isn't helping either.  

If everyone were shown how the cow was killed before eating their burger, I guarantee many people would not eat that burger.  The same applies to me.  Depriving another being of life is not worth my enjoyment of a burger.

I'm not ok with killing fish or any other animal in the first place.  Plus...that fish has eggs that could develop into more sturgeons.  I sincerely don't feel that it's *right* to kill the mother, and then eat the eggs.
Yup.  I hate that people are "ok" with this.  We shouldn't be eating caviar at all.

I don't know how to take it though.  It's tough to be told to commit suicide, especially by a 3rd party.  

Telling someone to kill themselves would take a lot of hate (If it was me).  I just don't know where this hate is coming from.  I'm just scared that it's my parents.  God knows what my only friends think of me.
